footer.tagline: Training is movement. AI brings precision.

movement.aria: Illustration of squat pose analysis with joint points and movement guides

m.label: FIT® / FOR MEMBERS
m.title: Strength.
m.lead: AI pose analysis, a clear training plan and a trainer alongside you. All in one training journey.
m.featuresTitle:
One app.
Your whole training journey.
m.featuresLead: From exercise videos to plans and a coach alongside you, all your data lives in one place.

features.label: 01 / POSE ANALYSIS
features.title: Understand every movement.
features.body: Record or upload an exercise video. AI points out what to adjust, moment by moment.

features.label: 02 / TRAINING PLAN
features.title: Train with direction.
features.body: Track targets and results for every set in one clear routine.

features.label: 03 / TRAINER
features.title: Never train alone.
features.body: Choose a trainer from a suitable gym to adjust your plan and follow your progress closely.

m.focusLead: Know what to train today, how many sets, and how far along you are against your goal.

o.label: FIT® / FOR GYM OWNERS
o.title: Your gym.
o.lead: Bring your gym, service packages and trainers to people looking for the right place to train.
o.visualAria: Illustration of a gym profile on the platform
o.stepsTitle:
One clear profile.
One place to start.
o.stepsLead: Three steps to get your gym on the platform and closer to members.

steps.label: 01 / COMPLETE
steps.title: Introduce your gym.
steps.body: Add location, amenities and photos that show your space and services as they are.

steps.label: 02 / REVIEW
steps.title: Ready to be seen.
steps.body: Submit your gym profile for review on the platform.

steps.label: 03 / CONNECT
steps.title: Get closer to members.
steps.body: Bring training packages, PT packages and your trainers to people looking for a gym.

o.offerLead: Publish the benefits, duration and price of each training or PT package. Follow transactions and settlements right on the platform.
o.commission: A 10% commission applies to the gym service portion. The platform's AI Plus portion is separate.
